function_or_audit: R/09_main_scientific_analysis.R nearest_distance_km; public verification uses stats::dist
pairwise_distance_step: Projected Euclidean distances in metres were calculated from each representative to all representatives.
diagonal_treatment: The scripted function sets the self-distance to Inf for each row; the equivalent stats::dist audit converts the distance object to a symmetric matrix and sets the diagonal to Inf.
row_minimum_step: The minimum finite value per row is retained as the nearest-neighbour distance.
repeated_coordinate_treatment: Repeated projected coordinates produce row minima of 0 km and are counted as co-localized representatives.
interpretation: Documentary clustering only; no exact coordinates are public.

function_or_audit: Equivalent row-minimum nearest-neighbour audit after retaining unique restricted latitude-longitude pairs
pairwise_distance_step: One row was retained per unique restricted latitude-longitude pair before projection.
diagonal_treatment: The pairwise projected Euclidean distance matrix used Inf on the diagonal.
row_minimum_step: The minimum finite value per unique coordinate pair was retained.
repeated_coordinate_treatment: Exact coordinate duplicates were removed before this calculation, so 0 km co-location is 0.
